title: Composite wall with convection on both sides (analytic)
description:
Steady 1D conduction through brick + insulation with convection on both faces.
Analytic: q_wall = (T_in - T_out) / (1/h_in + L1/k_brick + L2/k_ins + 1/h_out); T(x) is piecewise linear.
Derived values tab: q_brick and q_insulation (mean heat_flux_abs per layer) and the mean rises per layer against their references; exact up to float precision (error < 1e-5).
Line profile tab: T_profile (T along the wall vs the piecewise-linear exact profile; shows the last sweep value, the base k_ins).
Sweep tab: q_insulation vs k_ins with the analytic curve q_vs_k_ins.

parameters.name: h_in
parameters.description: inside heat transfer coefficient in W/(m^2 K)

parameters.name: h_out
parameters.description: outside heat transfer coefficient in W/(m^2 K)

parameters.name: L1
parameters.description: brick thickness in m (x from 0 to L1; must be a multiple of dx_mesh so the interface lies on a cell edge)

parameters.name: L2
parameters.description: insulation thickness in m (x from L1 to L1 + L2)

parameters.name: k_brick
parameters.description: brick thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: k_ins
parameters.description: insulation thermal conductivity in W/(m K); swept

parameters.name: H_wall
parameters.description: wall height in m (y faces insulated, so the solution is 1D)

parameters.name: q_wall
parameters.description: analytic heat flux through the wall in W/m^2 (about 10.19 at the base values)

analytic_curves.name: T_profile
analytic_curves.expression: T_in - q_wall*(1/h_in + where(x < L1, x/k_brick, L1/k_brick + (x - L1)/k_ins))
